correctness.rationale: The Rule22 one-step condition is sum of three adjacent binary bits exactly 1. The inspected t=5 space-time transfer construction is a finite 1024-state graph. A separate implementation generated 1023 edges and SCC sizes 1,2,16,16,16,16,16; one 16-state block has 18 edges, exactly three simple cycles lengths 11,12,13 with 9 vertices common. The inspected checker verifies the remaining four blocks exhaustively; common-vertex intersection precludes disjoint-cycle determinant products, so each block det(I-zB)=1-z^11-z^12-z^13, and -zQ'/Q gives its trace. The one-/two-cycle contributions cancel against F_n fixed points and division by the five temporal phases yields the orbit generating function for every n, not a finite extrapolation. The positive coefficient support is the semigroup <11,12,13>; its union intervals [11k,13k] have last missing values 53,54, conductor 55. An independent direct bit-state enumeration is finite corroboration, not the all-n proof.
